title: FAQs
intro: Answers to the questions readers ask most.
body:
## How do I buy an ePub?

Click **Buy the ePub direct** on any book page. Checkout is handled securely by Payhip, and you'll get a download link straight away, plus a copy by email.

## Can I read it on my Kindle?

Yes. Use Amazon's free **Send to Kindle** service (by email, the app or the website) to send the ePub to your Kindle. It converts automatically.

## Can I read it on Kobo, Apple Books or my phone?

Yes. ePub is the standard e-book format, so it opens in Kobo, Apple Books, Google Play Books and most reading apps.

## Why do some books only link to Amazon?

Some of our books are published through Amazon KDP, where they're available on Kindle. For those titles we link straight to Amazon.

## I didn't receive my download

Check your junk folder for the email from Payhip first. If it's not there, email us with your order details and we'll sort it.

## Can I get a refund?

Because e-books are delivered instantly, you agree at checkout that the 14-day cancellation period doesn't apply once the download starts. If a file is faulty or won't open, we'll replace it or refund you. See our refund policy.

## Are your books suitable for children?

Our Kids imprint is written for ages 3–5 and Knightlight Manga for ages 10–16. Our Fiction and Sci-Fi imprints are for adult readers, and the Romance section is for over-18s only.

## Will there be paperbacks?

We're planning print editions for some titles. Join the reading list to hear first.
